query:
SELECT pl.link_hash, u.name, u.email
FROM personalized_links pl
JOIN users u ON pl.student_id = u.id
WHERE u.email = 'jenifer.borges@influx.com.br'
ORDER BY pl.created_at DESC
LIMIT 1;
